release_notes: Build 139 fixes an app freeze that could appear after a YouTube Data API key was configured and YouTube analytics became active.

Upload Manager now builds its quiz-history, social-journal and per-project promo-status snapshot away from the WPF UI thread, preventing YouTube analytics refreshes from triggering blocking project-folder scans.
Upload Manager refreshes now use an overlap guard so repeated analytics, Library and upload-state refreshes cannot stack the same filesystem work.
YouTube API key storage, OAuth account connection and publishing behaviour are unchanged; this release is focused on responsiveness.
